# documented "Existing project" workflow (README Quick Start)
mkdir project
cd project

# musher bundle init --empty creates musher.yaml only
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle init --empty --yes
stderr 'Created musher.yaml'
exists musher.yaml
! exists skills

# place a conventional skill asset so add --all discovers it
mkdir skills/my-skill
cp $WORK/skill.md skills/my-skill/SKILL.md

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle add --all --yes
stderr 'Added'

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle validate

-- skill.md --
---
name: my-skill
description: A test skill
---

This is a test skill.
